text: City Council on December 5, 6, 7 and 8, 2017, referred Administrative Inquiry IA35.1 from Councillor Gord Perks, Ward 14, Parkdale-High Park regarding the cost of preventing information being released at Toronto Hydro and Answer IA35.1a from the City Manager to the Executive Committee for consideration.
